title: Lesson 1: 简单的爱情 (jiǎn dān de ài qíng) (Simple Love)

grammar.explanation: The conjunction “不仅” is used in the first clause and is often followed by “也/还/而且” in the second clause, adding a further meaning beyond the first clause. When the two clauses share the same subject, “不仅” is placed after the subject; when the subjects are different, “不仅” is placed before the first subject.

formal_examples.chinese: 他不仅足球踢得好，性格也不错。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn zúqiú tī dé hǎo, xìnggé yě bùcuò.
formal_examples.translation: Not only does he play football well, but his personality is also quite good.

formal_examples.chinese: 小时候，他经常生病，所以每天都去跑步锻炼身体。谁也没有想到，长大以后，他不仅身体健康，还成了一名长跑运动员。
formal_examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhòu, tā jīngcháng shēngbìng, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu qù pǎobù duànliàn shēntǐ. Shéi yě méiyǒu xiǎngdào, zhǎngdà yǐhòu, tā bùjǐn shēntǐ jiànkāng, hái chéngle yī míng chángpǎo yùndòngyuán.
formal_examples.translation: When he was a child, he often got sick, so he went running every day to exercise. No one expected that after growing up, he would not only be healthy but also become a long-distance runner.

formal_examples.chinese: 我打算去云南玩儿，听说那边不仅很美，而且人也非常热情。
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn qù Yúnnán wánr, tīngshuō nàbiān bùjǐn hěn měi, érqiě rén yě fēicháng rèqíng.
formal_examples.translation: I plan to go to Yunnan for fun. I heard that not only is it very beautiful there, but the people are also very enthusiastic.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 他不光球踢得贼溜，人还挺给力的。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Tā bùguāng qiú tī dé zéi liū, rén hái tǐng gěilì de.
colloquial_examples.translation: He's not just a pro at football, he's also a really stand-up guy.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 他不光身体棒得跟头牛似的，还成了个长跑健将。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Tā bùguāng shēntǐ bàng dé gēn tóu niú shì de, hái chéngle gè chángpǎo jiànjiàng.
colloquial_examples.translation: He's not just strong as an ox, he even became a pro long-distance runner.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 那地儿不光美得冒泡，人还特别好客。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Nà dìr bùguāng měi dé màopào, rén hái tèbié hàokè.
colloquial_examples.translation: That place is not just insanely beautiful, the people are super welcoming too.

grammar.nuance: In casual speech, '贼溜' (very smooth/skilled) and '美得冒泡' (bubbling with beauty) add a much more native flavor.

grammar.explanation: The adverb “从来” indicates that something has always been like this from the past to the present. It is usually used in negative sentences.

formal_examples.chinese: 老张这个人开会从来不迟到。今天到现在还没来，可能是有什么事情，你打个电话问问他吧。
formal_examples.pinyin: Lǎo Zhāng zhège rén kāihuì cónglái bù chídào. Jīntiān dào xiànzài hái méi lái, kěnéng shì yǒu shénme shìqing, nǐ dǎ gè diànhuà wènwen tā ba.
formal_examples.translation: Old Zhang never comes late to meetings. He still has not come today, so maybe something happened. Give him a call and ask him.

formal_examples.chinese: 虽然我们认识的时间不长，但我从来没这么快乐过。
formal_examples.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen rènshì de shíjiān bù cháng, dàn wǒ cónglái méi zhème kuàilè guò.
formal_examples.translation: Although we haven't known each other long, I have never been this happy.

formal_examples.chinese: 这家面馆儿从来只卖一种东西：牛肉面。因为面做得很好吃，而且不贵。很多新客人变成了老客人，老客人又带来更多新客人。
formal_examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā miànguǎnr cónglái zhǐ mài yī zhǒng dōngxī: niúròumiàn. Yīnwèi miàn zuò de hěn hǎochī, érqiě bú guì. Hěn duō xīn kèrén biànchéngle lǎo kèrén, lǎo kèrén yòu dài lái gèng duō xīn kèrén.
formal_examples.translation: This noodle shop has always only sold one thing: beef noodles. Because the noodles are delicious and not expensive, many new customers become regulars, and regulars bring even more new customers.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 老张开会压根儿就没迟到过，人稳得很。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Lǎo Zhāng kāihuì yàgēnr jiù méi chídào guò, rén wěn de hěn.
colloquial_examples.translation: Old Zhang has never once been late to a meeting; he's super reliable.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 打从认识他起，我压根儿没这么开心过！
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Dǎcóng rènshì tā qǐ, wǒ yàgenr méi zhème kāixīn guò!
colloquial_examples.translation: Ever since I met him, I haven't been this happy at all!

colloquial_examples.chinese: 这面馆儿一直以来就死磕一种面：牛肉面。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Zhè miànguǎnr yīzhí yǐlái jiù sǐkē yī zhǒng miàn: niúròumiàn.
colloquial_examples.translation: This noodle shop has been stuck on just one thing forever: beef noodles.

grammar.nuance: '压根儿没' and '死磕' (stubbornly focus on) are much more expressive and common in casual Northern Chinese dialect.

grammar.explanation: Indicates that an action or a situation took place only a while ago. Used after the subject and before the verb.

formal_examples.chinese: 我上午刚借的那本书，怎么找不到了？
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàngwǔ gāng jiè de nà běn shū, zěnme zhǎo bù dào le?
formal_examples.translation: I just borrowed that book this morning; how come I can't find it?

formal_examples.chinese:
A: 我刚从会议室过来，怎么一个人也没有？
B: 对不起，今天的会议改到明天上午了。
formal_examples.pinyin:
A: Wǒ gāng cóng huìyìshì guòlái, zěnme yí ge rén yě méiyǒu?
B: Duìbuqǐ, jīntiān de huìyì gǎi dào míngtiān shàngwǔ le.
formal_examples.translation:
A: I just came from the meeting room; how come there's no one there?
B: Sorry, today's meeting has been moved to tomorrow morning.

formal_examples.chinese: 我和丈夫刚结婚的时候，每天都觉得很新鲜，在一起有说不完的话。
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé zhàngfū gāng jiéhūn de shíhòu, měitiān dōu juédé hěn xīnxiān, zài yīqǐ yǒu shuō bù wán de huà.
formal_examples.translation: When my husband and I first got married, every day felt fresh, and we had endless things to talk about.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 我上午才借的那本书，咋一转眼就没了？
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàngwǔ cái jiè de nà běn shū, zǎ yī zhuǎnyǎn jiù méile?
colloquial_examples.translation: I only just borrowed that book this morning, how is it gone already?

colloquial_examples.chinese: 我前脚刚从会议室出来，后脚这就没人了？
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Wǒ qiánjiǎo gāng cóng huìyìshì chūlái, hòujiǎo zhè jiù méi rénle?
colloquial_examples.translation: I just stepped out of the meeting room and everyone's already gone?

colloquial_examples.chinese: 我跟我老公刚领证那会儿，每天一睁眼就觉得挺新鲜的。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn wǒ lǎogōng gāng lǐngzhèng nà huìr, měitiān yī zhēngyǎn jiù juédé hěn xīnxiān de.
colloquial_examples.translation: Back when my husband and I just got hitched, every day I woke up feeling everything was so fresh.

grammar.nuance: '领证' (registering marriage) and '前脚...后脚' (one after another) are very common colloquial terms.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction “即使” is used in the first clause, often coordinating with “也” in the second clause. The structure usually indicates a hypothetical concession, though it can also indicate something that has already happened or been in existence. “即使” can be used either before or after the subject of the first clause.

formal_examples.chinese: 你应该多回家看看老人，即使只是跟他们吃吃饭、聊聊天，他们也会觉得很幸福。
formal_examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi duō huí jiā kànkan lǎorén, jíshǐ zhǐshì gēn tāmen chīchi fàn, liáoliao tiān, tāmen yě huì juédé hěn xìngfú.
formal_examples.translation: You should go home more often to see the elderly; even if you just eat and chat with them, they will feel very happy.

formal_examples.chinese: 大部分人每天晚上最少应该睡7个小时，但有些人即使只睡5个小时也没问题。
formal_examples.pinyin: Dà bùfèn rén měitiān wǎnshàng zuìshǎo yīnggāi shuì qī gè xiǎoshí, dàn yǒuxiē rén jíshǐ zhǐ shuì wǔ gè xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
formal_examples.translation: Most people should sleep at least 7 hours every night, but for some people, even sleeping only 5 hours is no problem.

formal_examples.chinese: 浪漫是即使晚上加班到零点，到家时，自己家里也还亮着灯。
formal_examples.pinyin: Làngmàn shì jíshǐ wǎnshàng jiābān dào língdiǎn, dào jiā shí, zìjǐ jiālǐ yě hái liàngzhe dēng.
formal_examples.translation: Romance is even if you work overtime until midnight, when you get home, your own home's lights are still on.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 就算只是陪他们吃个饭唠唠嗑，老人家也乐得不行。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn zhǐshì péi tāmen chī gè fàn láolao kē, lǎorénjiā yě lè dé bùxíng.
colloquial_examples.translation: Even if you just grab a bite and chat with them, the elders will be over the moon.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 哪怕只睡五个钟头，有些人也照样精神百倍。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Nǎpà zhǐ shuì wǔ gè zhōngtou, yǒuxiē rén yě zhàoyàng jīngshén bǎibèi.
colloquial_examples.translation: Even if they only sleep five hours, some folks are still full of energy.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 就算忙得脚底板朝天, 到家还有盏灯留着，这就是浪漫。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn máng dé jiǎodǐbǎn cháotiān, dào jiā hái yǒu zhǎn dēng liúzhe, zhè jiùshì làngmàn.
colloquial_examples.translation: Even if you're swamped with work, having a light left on at home—that's romance.

grammar.nuance: '唠唠嗑' (to chat) and '忙得脚底板朝天' (extremely busy) are very vivid colloquialisms.

grammar.explanation: The noun of locality “上” is used after another noun, meaning “on the surface of an object” or “within a certain scope or regarding a certain aspect”.

formal_examples.chinese: 今天的作业是复习生词，明天课上听写。
formal_examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè shì fùxí shēngcí, míngtiān kè shàng tīngxiě.
formal_examples.translation: Today's homework is to review new words; there will be a dictation in class tomorrow.

formal_examples.chinese: 来北方好几年了吧？你觉得北方和南方在饮食上有什么不同？
formal_examples.pinyin: Lái běifāng hǎo jǐ nián le ba? Nǐ juédé běifāng hé nánfāng zài yǐnshí shàng yǒu shénme bùtóng?
formal_examples.translation: You've been in the north for several years, right? What differences do you think there are between the north and the south in terms of diet?

formal_examples.chinese: 两个人共同生活，不仅需要浪漫的爱情，更需要性格上互相吸引。
formal_examples.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, bùjǐn xūyào làngmàn de àiqíng, gèng xūyào xìnggé shàng hùxiāng xīyǐn.
formal_examples.translation: For two people to live together, it requires not only romantic love, but more importantly, mutual attraction in terms of personality.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 明天课上得听写，今晚赶紧把生词过一遍。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Míngtiān kè shàng děi tīngxiě, jīnwǎn gǎnjǐn bǎ shēngcí guò yībiàn.
colloquial_examples.translation: Dictation in class tomorrow, better go over those new words fast tonight.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 南北方的吃食这块儿，你觉得差在哪儿？
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Nánběifāng de chīshi zhè kuàir, nǐ juédé chà zài nǎr?
colloquial_examples.translation: Regarding the food scene between North and South, what's the big difference to you?

colloquial_examples.chinese: 说起性格那块儿, 他人挺仗义的, 踢球也贼溜。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Shuōqǐ xìnggé nà kuàir, tā rén tǐng zhàngyì de, tīqiú yě zéi liū.
colloquial_examples.translation: Speaking of his personality, he's a real stand-up guy and plays football like a boss.

grammar.nuance: Using '这块儿' (this area/aspect) or '说起...那块儿' is a very natural way to introduce a topic in conversation.

grammar.explanation: Similarity: both “刚” and “刚才” indicate that an action or situation took place not long ago, and both can serve as an adverbial modifier. Differences: “刚” is an adverb used only after the subject and before the verb, while “刚才” is a temporal noun that can be used either before or after the subject. “刚” can be preceded by a temporal word, while “刚才” cannot. In a sentence with “刚”, the verb can be followed by a word of duration, while “刚才” cannot. “刚才” can be followed by a negative word, while “刚” cannot.

formal_examples.chinese: 你叔叔刚/刚才打电话来说给你发了个电子邮件。
formal_examples.pinyin: Nǐ shūshu gāng/gāngcái dǎ diànhuà lái shuō gěi nǐ fāle ge diànzǐ yóujiàn.
formal_examples.translation: Your uncle just called and said he sent you an email.

formal_examples.chinese: 我刚看了邮箱，没有新邮件。
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng kànle yóuxiāng, méiyǒu xīn yóujiàn.
formal_examples.translation: I just checked the mailbox; there are no new emails.

formal_examples.chinese: 我刚才去洗手间了，你给我打电话了？
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái qù xǐshǒujiān le, nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà le?
formal_examples.translation: I went to the restroom just now. Did you call me?

formal_examples.chinese: 刚才我去洗手间了，你给我打电话了？
formal_examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ qù xǐshǒujiān le, nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà le?
formal_examples.translation: Just now I went to the restroom. Did you call me?

formal_examples.chinese: 我上个月刚结婚，正准备和我先生一起出去旅游。
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge yuè gāng jiéhūn, zhèng zhǔnbèi hé wǒ xiānsheng yìqǐ chūqù lǚyóu.
formal_examples.translation: I just got married last month and am preparing to travel with my husband.

formal_examples.chinese: 他刚来一会儿。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tā gāng lái yíhuìr.
formal_examples.translation: He just came a little while ago.

formal_examples.chinese: 你为什么刚才不说，现在才说？
formal_examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme gāngcái bù shuō, xiànzài cái shuō?
formal_examples.translation: Why did you not say it just now and only say it now?

colloquial_examples.chinese: 我刚刚看了邮箱，真没新邮件。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng kànle yóuxiāng, zhēn méi xīn yóujiàn.
colloquial_examples.translation: I just checked my inbox; there really are no new emails.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 你刚才怎么不说？现在说也太晚了吧。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāngcái zěnme bù shuō? Xiànzài shuō yě tài wǎn le ba.
colloquial_examples.translation: Why didn't you say it just now? Isn't it too late to say it now?

grammar.nuance: This is a comparison note rather than a new single pattern: “刚” behaves like an adverb in front of the verb, while “刚才” behaves like a time noun and can move more freely around the subject.

grammar.explanation: Words with the same character “感”: 感到, 感动, 感冒, 感兴趣.

formal_examples.chinese: 他的话让我感到事情有点儿不对。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tā de huà ràng wǒ gǎndào shìqing yǒu diǎnr bú duì.
formal_examples.translation: His words made me feel that something was a little wrong.

formal_examples.chinese: 这部电影讲的是一个浪漫的爱情故事，很多人都被感动得哭了。
formal_examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì yí ge làngmàn de àiqíng gùshi, hěn duō rén dōu bèi gǎndòng de kū le.
formal_examples.translation: This movie tells a romantic love story, and many people were moved to tears.

formal_examples.chinese:
A: 怎么了？生病了？
B: 有点儿发烧，还有点儿头疼，可能是感冒了。
formal_examples.pinyin:
A: Zěnme le? Shēngbìng le?
B: Yǒu diǎnr fāshāo, hái yǒu diǎnr tóuténg, kěnéng shì gǎnmào le.
formal_examples.translation:
A: What's wrong? Are you sick?
B: I have a bit of a fever and a headache. Maybe I caught a cold.

formal_examples.chinese: 很多留学生到中国学习汉语，是因为他们对中国文化感兴趣。
formal_examples.pinyin: Hěn duō liúxuéshēng dào Zhōngguó xuéxí Hànyǔ, shì yīnwèi tāmen duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gǎn xìngqù.
formal_examples.translation: Many international students come to China to study Chinese because they are interested in Chinese culture.

grammar.colloquial_pattern: 感觉 / 被打动 / 感冒了 / 感兴趣

colloquial_examples.chinese: 他这么一说，我感觉这事儿有点不太对劲。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Tā zhème yì shuō, wǒ gǎnjué zhè shìr yǒu diǎn bù tài duìjìn.
colloquial_examples.translation: Once he said that, I felt something was a bit off.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 那电影太戳人了，好多人都被打动哭了。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Nà diànyǐng tài chuō rén le, hǎo duō rén dōu bèi dǎdòng kū le.
colloquial_examples.translation: That movie really hit people emotionally; many were moved to tears.

grammar.nuance: This is an expansion note for words sharing the character “感”, not a single grammar pattern. The formal examples preserve the textbook's word-family usage.

key_sentences.sentence: 虽然我们认识的时间不长，但我从来没这么快乐过。
key_sentences.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen rènshì de shíjiān bù cháng, dàn wǒ cónglái méi zhème kuàilè guò.
key_sentences.translation: Although we haven't known each other for long, I've never been this happy.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 认识没多久，但我这辈子都压根儿没这么爽过！
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Rènshì méi duōjiǔ, dàn wǒ zhè bèizi dōu yàgenr méi zhème shuǎng guò!
key_sentences.context: Expressing intense happiness in a new relationship.

key_sentences.sentence: 两个人共同生活，只有浪漫和新鲜感是不够的。
key_sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, zhǐyǒu làngmàn hé xīnxiāngǎn shì bùgòu de.
key_sentences.translation: Living together, romance and a sense of freshness alone are not enough.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 过日子嘛，光靠浪漫和新鲜劲儿可撑不下去。
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Guò rìzi ma, guāng kào làngmàn hé xīnxiānjìnr kě chēng bù xiàqù.
key_sentences.context: Giving realistic advice about long-term relationships.

key_sentences.sentence: 我能想到最浪漫的事，就是和你一起慢慢变老。
key_sentences.pinyin: Wǒ néng xiǎngdào zuì làngmàn de shì, jiùshì hé nǐ yīqǐ mànman biàn lǎo.
key_sentences.translation: The most romantic thing I can think of is growing old with you slowly.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 这辈子能跟你一块儿变老，我就知足了。
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Zhè bèizi néng gēn nǐ yīkuàir biàn lǎo, wǒ jiù zhīzú le.

key_sentences.sentence: 其实，让我们感动的，就是生活中简单的爱情。
key_sentences.pinyin: Qíshí, ràng wǒmen gǎndòng de, jiùshì shēnghuó zhōng jiǎndān de àiqíng.
key_sentences.translation: In fact, what moves us is the simple love in life.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 说白了，最戳人的还是那些平平淡淡的小确幸。
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Shuō báile, zuì chuōrén de háishì nàxiē píngpíng dàndàn de xiǎo què xìng.
key_sentences.context: Reflecting on the beauty of simple love.

texts.title: 孙月和王静聊王静的男朋友 (sūn yuè hé wáng jìng liáo wáng jìng de nán péng yǒu) (Sun Yue and Wang Jing talk about Wang Jing's boyfriend)

content.speaker: 孙月
content.text: 听说你男朋友李进跟你是一个学校的，是你同学吗？
content.pinyin: Tīng shuō nǐ nán péngyǒu Lǐ Jìn gēn nǐ shì yīgè xuéxiào de, shì nǐ tóngxué ma?
content.translation: I heard that your boyfriend Li Jin is from the same school as you. Is he your classmate?

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 是的，他学的是新闻，我学的是法律，我和他不是一个班。
content.pinyin: Shì de, tā xué de shì xīnwén, wǒ xué de shì fǎlǜ, wǒ hé tā bùshì yīgè bān.
content.translation: Yes, he studies journalism, and I study law. We are not in the same class.

content.speaker: 孙月
content.text: 那你们俩是怎么认识的？
content.pinyin: Nà nǐmen liǎ shì zěnme rènshì de?
content.translation: Then how did you two meet?

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 我们是在一次足球比赛中认识的。我们班跟他们班比赛，他一个人踢进两个球，我对他印象很深，后来就慢慢熟悉了。
content.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zài yīcì zúqiú bǐsài zhōng rènshi de. Wǒmen bān gēn tāmen bān bǐsài, tā yīgè rén tī jìn liǎng gè qiú, wǒ duì tā yìnxiàng hěn shēn, hòulái jiù mànman shúxi le.
content.translation: We met during a football match. Our class played against theirs. He scored two goals by himself, and I was very impressed by him. Later, we gradually got to know each other.

content.speaker: 孙月
content.text: 你为什么喜欢他？
content.pinyin: Nǐ wèishéme xǐhuān tā?
content.translation: Why do you like him?

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 他不仅足球踢得好，性格也不错。
content.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn zúqiú tī dé hǎo, xìnggé yě bùcuò.
content.translation: Not only does he play football well, but his personality is also quite good.

texts.title: 王静跟李老师聊她要结婚的事情 (wáng jìng gēn lǐ lǎo shī liáo tā yào jié hūn de shì qíng) (Wang Jing talks to Teacher Li about her marriage)

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 李老师，我下个月5号就要结婚了。
content.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī, wǒ xià gè yuè 5 hào jiù yào jiéhūn le.
content.translation: Teacher Li, I am getting married on the 5th of next month.

content.speaker: 李老师
content.text: 你是在开玩笑吧？你们不是才认识一个月？
content.pinyin: Nǐ shì zài kāi wánxiào ba? Nǐmen bùshì cái rènshì yīgè yuè?
content.translation: You're joking, right? Haven't you only known each other for a month?

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 虽然我们认识的时间不长，但我从来没这么快乐过。
content.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen rènshi de shíjiān bù cháng, dàn wǒ cónglái méi zhème kuàilè guò.
content.translation: Although we haven't known each other for long, I've never been this happy.

content.speaker: 李老师
content.text: 两个人在一起，最好能有共同的兴趣和爱好。
content.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén zài yīqǐ, zuìhǎo néng yǒu gòngtóng de xìngqù hé àihào.
content.translation: When two people are together, it's best to have common interests and hobbies.

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 我们有很多共同的爱好，经常一起打球、唱歌、做菜。
content.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu hěnduō gòngtóng de àihào, jīngcháng yīqǐ dǎqiú, chànggē, zuòcài.
content.translation: We have many common hobbies; we often play ball, sing, and cook together.

content.speaker: 李老师
content.text: 看来你真的找到适合你的人了。祝你们幸福！
content.pinyin: Kàn lái nǐ zhēnde zhǎodào shìhé nǐ de rén le. Zhù nǐmen xìngfú!
content.translation: It seems you've really found the right person for you. I wish you happiness!

texts.title: 高老师和李老师聊结婚后的生活 (gāo lǎo shī hé lǐ lǎo shī liáo jié hūn hòu de shēng huó) (Teacher Gao and Teacher Li talk about married life)

content.speaker: 高老师
content.text: 听说您跟妻子结婚快二十年了？
content.pinyin: Tīng shuō nín gēn qīzi jiéhūn kuài èrshí nián le?
content.translation: I heard you've been married to your wife for nearly twenty years?

content.speaker: 李老师
content.text: 到6月9号，我们就结婚二十年了。这么多年，我们的生活一直挺幸福的。
content.pinyin: Dào liùyuè jiǔ hào, wǒmen jiù jiéhūn èrshí nián le. Zhème duō nián, wǒmen de shēnghuó yīzhí tǐng xìngfú de.
content.translation: By June 9th, we will have been married for twenty years. Over these years, our life has always been quite happy.

content.speaker: 高老师
content.text: 我和丈夫刚结婚的时候，每天都觉得很新鲜，在一起有说不完的话。但是现在……
content.pinyin: Wǒ hé zhàngfū gāng jiéhūn de shíhòu, měitiān dōu juédé hěn xīnxiān, zài yīqǐ yǒu shuō bù wán de huà. Dànshì xiànzài...
content.translation: When my husband and I first got married, every day felt fresh, and we had endless things to talk about. But now...

content.speaker: 李老师
content.text: 两个人共同生活，只有浪漫和新鲜感是不够的。
content.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, zhǐyǒu làngmàn hé xīnxiāngǎn shì bùgòu de.
content.translation: Living together, romance and a sense of freshness alone are not enough.

content.speaker: 高老师
content.text: 您说得对！我现在每天看到的都是他的缺点。
content.pinyin: Nín shuō dé duì! Wǒ xiànzài měitiān kàn dào de dōu shì tā de quēdiǎn.
content.translation: You're right! Now all I see every day are his shortcomings.

content.speaker: 李老师
content.text: 两个人在一起时间长了，就会有很多问题。只有接受了他的缺点，你们才能更好地一起生活。
content.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén zài yīqǐ shíjiān cháng le, jiù huì yǒu hěnduō wèntí. Zhǐyǒu jiēshòu le tā de quēdiǎn, nǐmen cáinéng gèng hǎo de yīqǐ shēnghuó.
content.translation: When two people are together for a long time, many problems will arise. Only by accepting his shortcomings can you live better together.

texts.title: 浪漫的爱情 (làng màn de ài qíng) (Romantic Love - Monologue)

content.speaker: 独白
content.text: 很多女孩子羡慕浪漫的爱情。那什么是浪漫呢？年轻人说：浪漫是她想要月亮时，你不会给她星星；中年人说：浪漫是即使晚上加班到零点，到家时，自己家里也还亮着灯；老年人说：浪漫其实就像歌中唱的那样，“我能想到最浪漫的事，就是和你一起慢慢变老。”其实，让我们感动的，就是生活中简单的爱情。有时候，简单就是最大的幸福。
content.pinyin: Hěnduō nǚháizi xiànmù làngmàn de àiqíng. Nà shénme shì làngmàn ne? Niánqīngrén shuō: Làngmàn shì tā xiǎngyào yuèliang shí, nǐ búhuì gěi tā xīngxing; zhōngniánrén shuō: Làngmàn shì jíshǐ wǎnshang jiābān dào língdiǎn, dàojiā shí, zìjǐ jiālǐ yě hái liàngzhe dēng; lǎoniánrén shuō: Làngmàn qíshí jiùxiàng gēzhōng chàng de nàyàng, "Wǒ néng xiǎngdào zuì làngmàn de shì, jiùshì hé nǐ yīqǐ mànman biànlǎo". Qíshí, ràng wǒmen gǎndòng de, jiùshì shēnghuózhōng jiǎndān de àiqíng. Yǒushíhòu, jiǎndān jiùshì zuìdà de xìngfú.
content.translation: Many girls envy romantic love. So what is romance? Young people say: romance is when she wants the moon, you won't give her a star; middle-aged people say: romance is even when working overtime until midnight, when you get home, the light in your house is still on; elderly people say: romance is actually like what is sung in the song, 'The most romantic thing I can think of is growing old with you slowly.' In fact, what moves us is the simple love in life. Sometimes, simplicity is the greatest happiness.

vocabulary.meaning: n. love (between a man and a woman)
v. to shine, to be lit

texts.title: 爱情与吸引 (ài qíng yǔ xī yǐn) (Love and Attraction - Monologue)

content.speaker: 独白
content.text: 说到结婚，人们就会很自然地想起爱情。爱情是结婚的重要原因，但两个人共同生活，不仅需要浪漫的爱情，更需要性格上互相吸引。我丈夫是个很幽默的人。即使是很普通的事情，从他嘴里说出来也会变得很有意思。在我难过的时候，他总是有办法让我高兴起来。而且他的脾气也不错，结婚快十年了，我们俩几乎没因为什么事红过脸，很多人都特别羡慕我们。
content.pinyin: Shuō dào jiéhūn, rénmen jiù huì hěn zìrán dì xiǎngqǐ àiqíng. Àiqíng shì jiéhūn de zhòngyào yuányīn, dàn liǎng gè rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, bùjǐn xūyào làngmàn de àiqíng, gèng xūyào xìnggé shàng hùxiāng xīyǐn. Wǒ zhàngfū shì gè hěn yōumò de rén. Jíshǐ shì hěn pǔtōng de shìqíng, cóng tā zuǐ lǐ shuō chūlái yě huì biàn dé hěn yǒuyìsi. Zài wǒ nánguò de shíhòu, tā zǒng shì yǒu bànfǎ ràng wǒ gāoxìng qǐlái. Érqiě tā de píqi yě bùcuò, jiéhūn kuài shí nián le, wǒmen liǎ jīhū méi yīnwèi shénme shì hóng guò liǎn, hěnduō rén dōu tèbié xiànmù wǒmen.
content.translation: When it comes to marriage, people naturally think of love. Love is an important reason for marriage, but living together not only requires romantic love, but also mutual attraction in personality. My husband is a very humorous person. Even very ordinary things become interesting when spoken from his mouth. When I am sad, he always has a way to cheer me up. And his temper is also quite good. Having been married for nearly ten years, we two have almost never turned red (argued) over anything; many people especially envy us.

formal_translation.ko: 그는 축구도 잘할 뿐만 아니라 성격도 좋다.
formal_translation.ja: 彼はサッカーが上手なだけでなく、性格もよい。
formal_translation.en: The conjunction “不仅” is used in the first clause and is often followed by “也/还/而且” in the second clause, adding a further meaning beyond the first clause. When the two clauses share the same subject, “不仅” is placed after the subject; when the subjects are different, “不仅” is placed before the first subject.

colloquial_translation.ko: 얘는 축구만 잘하는 게 아니라 사람도 정말 괜찮아.
colloquial_translation.ja: こいつ、サッカーがうまいだけじゃなくて人柄もかなりいい。
colloquial_translation.en: In casual speech, '贼溜' (very smooth/skilled) and '美得冒泡' (bubbling with beauty) add a much more native flavor.

translation.ko: 그는 축구를 잘할 뿐만 아니라 성격도 꽤 좋아요.
translation.ja: 彼はサッカーが上手なだけでなく、性格もなかなか良いです。
translation.en: Not only does he play football well, but his personality is also quite good.

translation.ko: 어릴 때 그는 자주 아팠기 때문에 매일 달리기로 몸을 단련했어요. 아무도 그가 커서 건강해질 뿐만 아니라 장거리 달리기 선수가 될 줄은 생각하지 못했어요.
translation.ja: 子どもの頃、彼はよく病気をしていたので、毎日走って体を鍛えていました。成長してから、体が健康になっただけでなく、長距離ランナーになるとは誰も思いませんでした。
translation.en: When he was a child, he often got sick, so he went running every day to exercise. No one expected that after growing up, he would not only be healthy but also become a long-distance runner.

translation.ko: 저는 윈난에 놀러 갈 계획이에요. 그곳은 아름다울 뿐만 아니라 사람들도 매우 따뜻하다고 들었어요.
translation.ja: 私は雲南へ遊びに行くつもりです。あそこは美しいだけでなく、人もとても親切だと聞きました。
translation.en: I plan to go to Yunnan for fun. I heard that not only is it very beautiful there, but the people are also very enthusiastic.

translation.ko: 그는 공도 정말 잘 차고 사람도 꽤 괜찮아요.
translation.ja: 彼はサッカーがめちゃくちゃ上手なだけでなく、人柄もかなりいいです。
translation.en: He's not just a pro at football, he's also a really stand-up guy.

translation.ko: 그는 몸도 엄청 튼튼하고 장거리 달리기 실력자까지 됐어요.
translation.ja: 彼は体がものすごく丈夫なだけでなく、長距離走の実力者にもなりました。
translation.en: He's not just strong as an ox, he even became a pro long-distance runner.

translation.ko: 그곳은 말도 안 되게 예쁠 뿐 아니라 사람들도 정말 친절해요.
translation.ja: あそこはめちゃくちゃ美しいだけでなく、人も本当に親切です。
translation.en: That place is not just insanely beautiful, the people are super welcoming too.

formal_translation.ko: 우리가 알게 된 지는 오래되지 않았지만, 나는 이렇게 행복해 본 적이 없다.
formal_translation.ja: 知り合ってまだ長くないが、こんなに幸せだったことはない。
formal_translation.en: The adverb “从来” indicates that something has always been like this from the past to the present. It is usually used in negative sentences.

colloquial_translation.ko: 그를 알고 난 뒤로 이렇게까지 행복했던 적은 진짜 한 번도 없어.
colloquial_translation.ja: 彼と知り合ってから、こんなに幸せだったことはマジで一度もない。
colloquial_translation.en: '压根儿没' and '死磕' (stubbornly focus on) are much more expressive and common in casual Northern Chinese dialect.

translation.ko: 라오장은 회의에 절대 늦지 않아요.
translation.ja: 張さんは会議に決して遅れません。
translation.en: Old Zhang never comes late to meetings. He still has not come today, so maybe something happened. Give him a call and ask him.

translation.ko: 우리가 알게 된 시간은 길지 않지만, 저는 이렇게 행복했던 적이 없어요.
translation.ja: 私たちは知り合ってまだ長くありませんが、私はこんなに幸せだったことがありません。
translation.en: Although we haven't known each other long, I have never been this happy.

translation.ko: 이 국수집은 예전부터 오직 한 가지, 소고기면만 팔아요.
translation.ja: この麺屋は昔から一つだけ、牛肉麺だけを売っています。
translation.en: This noodle shop has always only sold one thing: beef noodles. Because the noodles are delicious and not expensive, many new customers become regulars, and regulars bring even more new customers.

translation.ko: 라오장은 회의에 한 번도 늦은 적이 없어요. 정말 믿음직해요.
translation.ja: 張さんは会議に一度も遅れたことがありません。本当に安定感があります。
translation.en: Old Zhang has never once been late to a meeting; he's super reliable.

translation.ko: 그를 알게 된 뒤로 이렇게 행복했던 적이 정말 없어요!
translation.ja: 彼と知り合ってから、こんなに嬉しかったことは本当にありません！
translation.en: Ever since I met him, I haven't been this happy at all!

translation.ko: 이 국수집은 계속 한 가지 메뉴, 소고기면만 고집해 왔어요.
translation.ja: この麺屋はずっと一つの麺、牛肉麺だけにこだわってきました。
translation.en: This noodle shop has been stuck on just one thing forever: beef noodles.

formal_translation.ko: 공통점: 둘 다 동작이나 상황이 얼마 전에 일어났음을 나타내며 부사어로 쓰일 수 있습니다. 차이점: '刚'은 부사로 주어 뒤, 동사 앞에만 놓이고, '刚才'는 시간 명사로 주어 앞이나 뒤에 모두 올 수 있습니다. '刚' 앞에는 시간 표현이 올 수 있지만 '刚才' 앞에는 올 수 없습니다. '刚'을 쓴 문장에서는 동사 뒤에 시간량 표현이 올 수 있지만 '刚才'는 그렇지 않습니다. '刚才' 뒤에는 부정어가 올 수 있지만 '刚' 뒤에는 올 수 없습니다.
formal_translation.ja: 共通点: どちらも動作や状況が少し前に起きたことを表し、連用修飾語として使えます。違い: 「刚」は副詞で、主語の後、動詞の前にだけ置かれますが、「刚才」は時間名詞で、主語の前にも後にも置けます。「刚」の前には時間を表す語句を置けますが、「刚才」の前には置けません。「刚」を用いる文では動詞の後に時間量を表す語句を置けますが、「刚才」はできません。「刚才」の後には否定語を置けますが、「刚」はできません。
formal_translation.en: Similarity: both “刚” and “刚才” indicate that an action or situation took place not long ago, and both can serve as an adverbial modifier. Differences: “刚” is an adverb used only after the subject and before the verb, while “刚才” is a temporal noun that can be used either before or after the subject. “刚” can be preceded by a temporal word, while “刚才” cannot. In a sentence with “刚”, the verb can be followed by a word of duration, while “刚才” cannot. “刚才” can be followed by a negative word, while “刚” cannot.

colloquial_translation.ko: 이 항목은 단일 문형이 아니라 비교 설명입니다. '刚'은 동사 앞 부사처럼 쓰이고, '刚才'는 시간 명사처럼 주어 앞뒤로 더 자유롭게 움직입니다.
colloquial_translation.ja: これは単一の文型ではなく比較説明です。「刚」は動詞の前の副詞のように働き、「刚才」は時間名詞のように主語の前後をより自由に移動できます。
colloquial_translation.en: This is a comparison note rather than a new single pattern: “刚” behaves like an adverb in front of the verb, while “刚才” behaves like a time noun and can move more freely around the subject.

translation.ko: 삼촌이 방금 전화해서 당신에게 이메일을 보냈다고 했어요.
translation.ja: おじさんがさっき電話して、あなたにメールを送ったと言っていました。
translation.en: Your uncle just called and said he sent you an email.

translation.ko: 저는 방금 메일함을 봤는데 새 메일이 없어요.
translation.ja: 私は今メールボックスを見たばかりですが、新しいメールはありません。
translation.en: I just checked the mailbox; there are no new emails.

translation.ko: 저는 방금 화장실에 갔어요. 저에게 전화했나요?
translation.ja: 私はさっきトイレに行っていました。私に電話しましたか。
translation.en: I went to the restroom just now. Did you call me?

translation.ko: 방금 제가 화장실에 갔어요. 저에게 전화했나요?
translation.ja: さっき私はトイレに行っていました。私に電話しましたか。
translation.en: Just now I went to the restroom. Did you call me?

translation.ko: 저는 지난달에 막 결혼해서 남편과 함께 여행을 가려고 준비 중입니다.
translation.ja: 私は先月結婚したばかりで、夫と一緒に旅行に出かける準備をしています。
translation.en: I just got married last month and am preparing to travel with my husband.

translation.ko: 그는 방금 잠깐 왔어요.
translation.ja: 彼は来たばかりで少ししか経っていません。
translation.en: He just came a little while ago.

translation.ko: 왜 방금 말하지 않고 지금에야 말해요?
translation.ja: どうしてさっき言わずに、今になって言うのですか。
translation.en: Why did you not say it just now and only say it now?

translation.ko: 방금 메일함을 봤는데, 정말 새 메일이 없어요.
translation.ja: 今メールボックスを見たばかりですが、本当に新しいメールはありません。
translation.en: I just checked my inbox; there really are no new emails.

translation.ko: 방금 왜 말하지 않았어요? 지금 말하면 너무 늦은 거 아닌가요?
translation.ja: さっきどうして言わなかったのですか。今言っても遅すぎるのではありませんか。
translation.en: Why didn't you say it just now? Isn't it too late to say it now?

formal_translation.ko: 같은 글자 '感'을 포함한 단어: 感到, 感动, 感冒, 感兴趣.
formal_translation.ja: 同じ字「感」を含む語: 感到、感动、感冒、感兴趣。
formal_translation.en: Words with the same character “感”: 感到, 感动, 感冒, 感兴趣.

colloquial_translation.ko: 이 항목은 하나의 문법 패턴이 아니라 '感'이 들어간 단어군 확장 노트입니다.
colloquial_translation.ja: これは一つの文法パターンではなく、「感」を含む語群の拡張ノートです。
colloquial_translation.en: This is an expansion note for words sharing the character “感”, not a single grammar pattern. The formal examples preserve the textbook's word-family usage.

translation.ko: 그의 말은 제가 뭔가 좀 잘못됐다고 느끼게 했습니다.
translation.ja: 彼の話を聞いて、私は何か少しおかしいと感じました。
translation.en: His words made me feel that something was a little wrong.

translation.ko: 이 영화는 낭만적인 사랑 이야기를 다루며, 많은 사람이 감동해서 울었습니다.
translation.ja: この映画はロマンチックな愛の物語を描いており、多くの人が感動して泣きました。
translation.en: This movie tells a romantic love story, and many people were moved to tears.

translation.ko:
A: 왜 그래요? 아픈가요?
B: 열이 조금 나고 머리도 조금 아파요. 감기에 걸린 것 같아요.
translation.ja:
A: どうしましたか。病気ですか。
B: 少し熱があって、頭も少し痛いです。風邪をひいたのかもしれません。
translation.en:
A: What's wrong? Are you sick?
B: I have a bit of a fever and a headache. Maybe I caught a cold.

translation.ko: 많은 유학생이 중국에 와서 중국어를 배우는 것은 그들이 중국 문화에 관심이 있기 때문입니다.
translation.ja: 多くの留学生が中国に来て中国語を学ぶのは、中国文化に興味があるからです。
translation.en: Many international students come to China to study Chinese because they are interested in Chinese culture.

translation.ko: 그가 그렇게 말하자, 저는 이 일이 좀 이상하다고 느꼈어요.
translation.ja: 彼がそう言ったので、私はこの件が少し変だと感じました。
translation.en: Once he said that, I felt something was a bit off.

translation.ko: 그 영화는 정말 마음을 찔러서 많은 사람이 감동해 울었어요.
translation.ja: あの映画は本当に心に刺さって、多くの人が感動して泣きました。
translation.en: That movie really hit people emotionally; many were moved to tears.

formal_translation.ko: 매일 너무 바빠 쉴 시간이 없더라도 그는 여전히 행복하다고 느낀다.
formal_translation.ja: 毎日忙しすぎて休む時間がなくても、彼はやはり幸せだと感じている。
formal_translation.en: The conjunction “即使” is used in the first clause, often coordinating with “也” in the second clause. The structure usually indicates a hypothetical concession, though it can also indicate something that has already happened or been in existence. “即使” can be used either before or after the subject of the first clause.

colloquial_translation.ko: 아무리 일이 미친 듯이 많아도 그는 그 나름대로 즐기고 있어.
colloquial_translation.ja: どれだけ仕事に追われても、彼はなんだかんだ楽しんでいる。
colloquial_translation.en: '唠唠嗑' (to chat) and '忙得脚底板朝天' (extremely busy) are very vivid colloquialisms.

translation.ko: 어르신들을 더 자주 찾아뵈어야 해요. 함께 밥을 먹고 이야기만 해도 그분들은 매우 행복해하실 거예요.
translation.ja: 年配の方にはもっとよく会いに帰るべきです。たとえ一緒に食事をして話すだけでも、とても喜んでくれるでしょう。
translation.en: You should go home more often to see the elderly; even if you just eat and chat with them, they will feel very happy.

translation.ko: 대부분의 사람은 매일 밤 최소 7시간은 자야 하지만, 어떤 사람들은 5시간만 자도 문제가 없어요.
translation.ja: 多くの人は毎晩少なくとも7時間眠るべきですが、5時間だけ眠っても問題ない人もいます。
translation.en: Most people should sleep at least 7 hours every night, but for some people, even sleeping only 5 hours is no problem.

translation.ko: 로맨스란 자정까지 야근하더라도 집에 돌아왔을 때 집 불이 여전히 켜져 있는 것입니다.
translation.ja: ロマンとは、たとえ深夜まで残業しても、家に帰ると自分の家の明かりがまだついていることです。
translation.en: Romance is even if you work overtime until midnight, when you get home, your own home's lights are still on.

translation.ko: 같이 밥 먹고 수다만 떨어도 어르신들은 정말 기뻐하실 거예요.
translation.ja: 一緒にご飯を食べておしゃべりするだけでも、お年寄りは本当に喜んでくれます。
translation.en: Even if you just grab a bite and chat with them, the elders will be over the moon.

translation.ko: 어떤 사람들은 다섯 시간만 자도 여전히 에너지가 넘쳐요.
translation.ja: 五時間しか寝なくても、元気いっぱいな人もいます。
translation.en: Even if they only sleep five hours, some folks are still full of energy.

translation.ko: 일에 치여도 집에 불 하나 켜져 있으면, 그게 바로 로맨스예요.
translation.ja: 仕事でへとへとでも、家に明かりが一つ残っている。それがロマンです。
translation.en: Even if you're swamped with work, having a light left on at home—that's romance.

formal_translation.ko: 성격 면에서 보면 그는 축구도 잘하고 성격도 좋다.
formal_translation.ja: 性格の面で言えば、彼はサッカーも上手だし性格もよい。
formal_translation.en: The noun of locality “上” is used after another noun, meaning “on the surface of an object” or “within a certain scope or regarding a certain aspect”.

colloquial_translation.ko: 성격 얘기로 하면 얘 진짜 의리 있고 축구도 엄청 잘해.
colloquial_translation.ja: 性格って面で言えば、こいつは義理堅いしサッカーもうまい。
colloquial_translation.en: Using '这块儿' (this area/aspect) or '说起...那块儿' is a very natural way to introduce a topic in conversation.

translation.ko: 오늘 숙제는 새 단어를 복습하는 것입니다. 내일 수업 시간에 받아쓰기가 있을 거예요.
translation.ja: 今日の宿題は新出単語を復習することです。明日の授業で書き取りがあります。
translation.en: Today's homework is to review new words; there will be a dictation in class tomorrow.

translation.ko: 당신은 북방에 몇 년 있었죠? 음식 면에서 북방과 남방에 어떤 차이가 있다고 생각하세요?
translation.ja: あなたは北方に何年かいましたよね。食事の面で、北方と南方にはどんな違いがあると思いますか。
translation.en: You've been in the north for several years, right? What differences do you think there are between the north and the south in terms of diet?

translation.ko: 두 사람이 함께 살려면 낭만적인 사랑뿐만 아니라, 더 중요한 것은 성격 면에서 서로 끌리는 것입니다.
translation.ja: 二人が一緒に暮らすには、ロマンチックな愛だけでなく、より大切なのは性格の面で互いに惹かれ合うことです。
translation.en: For two people to live together, it requires not only romantic love, but more importantly, mutual attraction in terms of personality.

translation.ko: 내일 수업에서 받아쓰기 하니까, 오늘 밤 새 단어 빨리 복습하는 게 좋아요.
translation.ja: 明日の授業で書き取りがあるから、今夜は新出単語を早めに復習した方がいいです。
translation.en: Dictation in class tomorrow, better go over those new words fast tonight.

translation.ko: 남북 음식 쪽으로 보면, 당신은 뭐가 제일 다르다고 느껴요?
translation.ja: 南北の食べ物について言うと、何が一番違うと感じますか。
translation.en: Regarding the food scene between North and South, what's the big difference to you?

translation.ko: 그 사람 성격 얘기를 하자면, 정말 괜찮은 사람이고 축구도 엄청 잘해요.
translation.ja: 彼の性格について言えば、本当にいい人だし、サッカーもすごく上手です。
translation.en: Speaking of his personality, he's a real stand-up guy and plays football like a boss.

formal_translation.ko: '刚'은 어떤 동작이나 상황이 얼마 전에 막 일어났음을 나타내는 부사입니다. 보통 주어 뒤, 동사 앞에 놓입니다.
formal_translation.ja: 「刚」は、ある動作や状況が少し前に起きたばかりであることを表す副詞です。普通、主語の後、動詞の前に置かれます。
formal_translation.en: Indicates that an action or a situation took place only a while ago. Used after the subject and before the verb.

colloquial_translation.ko: 일상 대화에서는 '刚'으로 '막 ~했다'는 느낌을 간단히 표현하고, '刚才'는 '방금 전'이라는 시간 명사처럼 더 독립적으로 씁니다.
colloquial_translation.ja: 日常会話では「刚」で「〜したばかり」という感じを簡単に表し、「刚才」は「さっき」という時間名詞のようにより独立して使います。
colloquial_translation.en: '领证' (registering marriage) and '前脚...后脚' (one after another) are very common colloquial terms.

translation.ko: 저는 오늘 아침에 막 그 책을 빌렸는데, 왜 찾을 수 없죠?
translation.ja: 私は今朝その本を借りたばかりなのに、どうして見つからないのでしょうか。
translation.en: I just borrowed that book this morning; how come I can't find it?

translation.ko:
A: 저는 방금 회의실에서 왔는데, 왜 아무도 없죠?
B: 죄송합니다. 오늘 회의는 내일 오전으로 변경되었습니다.
translation.ja:
A: 私はさっき会議室から来たばかりなのに、どうして誰もいないのですか。
B: すみません。今日の会議は明日の午前に変更になりました。
translation.en:
A: I just came from the meeting room; how come there's no one there?
B: Sorry, today's meeting has been moved to tomorrow morning.

translation.ko: 남편과 제가 막 결혼했을 때는 매일이 새롭게 느껴졌고, 끝없이 할 이야기가 있었어요.
translation.ja: 夫と私が結婚したばかりの頃は、毎日が新鮮に感じられ、話すことが尽きませんでした。
translation.en: When my husband and I first got married, every day felt fresh, and we had endless things to talk about.

translation.ko: 오늘 아침에 막 빌린 책인데 벌써 없어졌다고요?
translation.ja: 今朝借りたばかりの本なのに、もうなくなったんですか。
translation.en: I only just borrowed that book this morning, how is it gone already?

translation.ko: 방금 회의실에서 나왔는데 벌써 다 가 버렸어요?
translation.ja: さっき会議室を出たばかりなのに、もうみんな帰ったんですか。
translation.en: I just stepped out of the meeting room and everyone's already gone?

translation.ko: 남편이랑 막 결혼했을 때는 매일 아침 모든 게 새롭게 느껴졌어요.
translation.ja: 夫と結婚したばかりの頃は、毎朝すべてが新鮮に感じられました。
translation.en: Back when my husband and I just got hitched, every day I woke up feeling everything was so fresh.

translation.ko: 우리가 알게 된 지는 오래되지 않았지만, 나는 이렇게 행복했던 적이 없다.
translation.ja: 知り合ってまだ長くないけれど、こんなに幸せだったことはない。
translation.en: Although we haven't known each other for long, I've never been this happy.

colloquial_translation.ko: 알게 된 지 얼마 안 됐는데도 이렇게 행복한 건 처음이야.
colloquial_translation.ja: 知り合ってまだそんなに経ってないのに、こんなに幸せなのは初めてだ。
colloquial_translation.en: 认识没多久，但我这辈子都压根儿没这么爽过！

context.ko: 새로운 연애에서 느끼는 큰 행복을 표현할 때.
context.ja: 新しい恋愛で感じる大きな幸福を表すとき。
context.en: Expressing intense happiness in a new relationship.

translation.ko: 두 사람이 함께 살아가려면 낭만과 설렘만으로는 부족하다.
translation.ja: 二人で暮らしていくには、ロマンや新鮮さだけでは足りない。
translation.en: Living together, romance and a sense of freshness alone are not enough.

colloquial_translation.ko: 같이 살다 보면 낭만이랑 설렘만으론 절대 안 돼.
colloquial_translation.ja: 一緒に暮らすなら、ロマンとときめきだけじゃやっていけない。
colloquial_translation.en: 过日子嘛，光靠浪漫和新鲜劲儿可撑不下去。

context.ko: 장기적인 관계에 대한 현실적인 조언을 할 때.
context.ja: 長い関係について現実的な助言をするとき。
context.en: Giving realistic advice about long-term relationships.

translation.ko: 내가 생각할 수 있는 가장 낭만적인 일은 너와 함께 천천히 늙어 가는 것이다.
translation.ja: 私が思ういちばんロマンチックなことは、あなたと一緒にゆっくり年を重ねることだ。
translation.en: The most romantic thing I can think of is growing old with you slowly.

colloquial_translation.ko: 평생 너랑 같이 늙어 갈 수 있으면 그걸로 충분해.
colloquial_translation.ja: 一生あなたと一緒に年を取れたら、それで十分だ。
colloquial_translation.en: 这辈子能跟你一块儿变老，我就知足了。

context.ja: 深く長く続く愛を表すとき。

translation.ko: 사실 우리를 감동시키는 것은 삶 속의 소박한 사랑이다.
translation.ja: 実は、私たちの心を動かすのは暮らしの中の素朴な愛だ。
translation.en: In fact, what moves us is the simple love in life.

colloquial_translation.ko: 결국 사람 마음을 움직이는 건 소소하고 담백한 사랑이야.
colloquial_translation.ja: 結局いちばん心に響くのは、ささやかで穏やかな愛なんだ。
colloquial_translation.en: 说白了，最戳人的还是那些平平淡淡的小确幸。

context.ja: 何気ない愛の美しさを振り返るとき。
context.en: Reflecting on the beauty of simple love.

translation.ko: 네 남자친구 리진이 너랑 같은 학교라던데, 네 동창이야?
translation.ja: あなたの彼氏の李進って、あなたと同じ学校なんでしょう？同級生なの？
translation.en: I heard that your boyfriend Li Jin is from the same school as you. Is he your classmate?

translation.ko: 응, 그는 신문학을 전공하고 나는 법을 전공해. 그래서 같은 반은 아니야.
translation.ja: うん、彼は新聞学で私は法律を専攻しているの。同じクラスではないよ。
translation.en: Yes, he studies journalism, and I study law. We are not in the same class.

translation.ko: 그럼 너희 둘은 어떻게 알게 된 거야?
translation.ja: じゃあ、二人はどうやって知り合ったの？
translation.en: Then how did you two meet?

translation.ko: 우리는 축구 경기에서 알게 됐어. 우리 반이 그들 반과 시합했는데, 그가 혼자 두 골을 넣어서 인상이 아주 깊었고, 그 뒤로 천천히 친해졌어.
translation.ja: 私たちはサッカーの試合で知り合ったの。うちのクラスが彼らのクラスと試合をして、彼が一人で二点入れたからすごく印象に残って、そのあと少しずつ親しくなったの。
translation.en: We met during a football match. Our class played against theirs. He scored two goals by himself, and I was very impressed by him. Later, we gradually got to know each other.

translation.ko: 너는 왜 그를 좋아해?
translation.ja: どうして彼のことが好きなの？
translation.en: Why do you like him?

translation.ko: 그는 축구도 잘할 뿐만 아니라 성격도 좋아.
translation.ja: 彼はサッカーが上手なだけでなく、性格もいいの。
translation.en: Not only does he play football well, but his personality is also quite good.

translation.ko: 이 선생님, 저 다음 달 5일에 결혼해요.
translation.ja: 李先生、私、来月5日に結婚するんです。
translation.en: Teacher Li, I am getting married on the 5th of next month.

translation.ko: 농담하는 거니? 너희 아직 안 지 한 달밖에 안 됐잖아?
translation.ja: 冗談でしょう？あなたたち、知り合ってまだ一か月しか経っていないでしょう？
translation.en: You're joking, right? Haven't you only known each other for a month?

translation.ko: 우리가 알게 된 지는 오래되지 않았지만, 저는 이렇게 행복했던 적이 없어요.
translation.ja: 知り合ってまだ長くはありませんが、こんなに幸せだったことはありません。
translation.en: Although we haven't known each other for long, I've never been this happy.

translation.ko: 두 사람이 함께하려면 공통의 관심사와 취미가 있는 게 가장 좋단다.
translation.ja: 二人が一緒にいるなら、共通の興味や趣味があるのがいちばんいいよ。
translation.en: When two people are together, it's best to have common interests and hobbies.

translation.ko: 저희는 공통 취미가 정말 많아요. 자주 같이 공도 치고, 노래도 하고, 요리도 해요.
translation.ja: 私たちは共通の趣味がたくさんあります。よく一緒に球技をしたり、歌ったり、料理したりします。
translation.en: We have many common hobbies; we often play ball, sing, and cook together.

translation.ko: 정말 너에게 잘 맞는 사람을 찾은 것 같구나. 행복하길 바란다!
translation.ja: 本当にあなたに合う人を見つけたみたいだね。幸せを祈っているよ。
translation.en: It seems you've really found the right person for you. I wish you happiness!

translation.ko: 선생님은 사모님과 결혼하신 지 거의 20년 되셨다면서요?
translation.ja: 先生は奥さまと結婚してもうすぐ20年になるそうですね？
translation.en: I heard you've been married to your wife for nearly twenty years?

translation.ko: 6월 9일이 되면 저희는 결혼 20주년이 됩니다. 이렇게 오랜 세월 동안 우리 생활은 늘 꽤 행복했어요.
translation.ja: 6月9日になれば、私たちは結婚20周年になります。これまでずっと、私たちの暮らしはかなり幸せでした。
translation.en: By June 9th, we will have been married for twenty years. Over these years, our life has always been quite happy.

translation.ko: 저도 남편과 막 결혼했을 때는 매일이 참 새로웠고, 함께 있으면 끝도 없이 할 말이 있었어요. 그런데 지금은……
translation.ja: 私も夫と結婚したばかりのころは毎日が新鮮で、一緒にいると話が尽きませんでした。でも今は……
translation.en: When my husband and I first got married, every day felt fresh, and we had endless things to talk about. But now...

translation.ko: 두 사람이 함께 살아가려면 낭만과 신선함만으로는 부족합니다.
translation.ja: 二人で生活するには、ロマンや新鮮さだけでは足りません。
translation.en: Living together, romance and a sense of freshness alone are not enough.

translation.ko: 맞는 말씀이에요! 요즘은 매일 그의 단점만 보여요.
translation.ja: おっしゃる通りです！今は毎日、彼の短所ばかりが目につきます。
translation.en: You're right! Now all I see every day are his shortcomings.

translation.ko: 두 사람이 함께 있는 시간이 길어지면 많은 문제가 생기게 됩니다. 그의 단점을 받아들여야 더 잘 함께 살아갈 수 있어요.
translation.ja: 二人が一緒にいる時間が長くなると、いろいろな問題が出てきます。彼の短所を受け入れてこそ、もっとよく一緒に暮らしていけるのです。
translation.en: When two people are together for a long time, many problems will arise. Only by accepting his shortcomings can you live better together.

translation.ko: 많은 여자아이들이 낭만적인 사랑을 부러워한다. 그렇다면 낭만이란 무엇일까? 젊은 사람들은 말한다. 그녀가 달을 원할 때 별을 주지 않는 것이 낭만이라고. 중년의 사람들은 말한다. 밤늦게 야근해 자정이 되어 집에 돌아와도 집 안에 여전히 불이 켜져 있는 것이 낭만이라고. 노년의 사람들은 말한다. 낭만은 사실 노래 가사처럼 “내가 생각할 수 있는 가장 낭만적인 일은 너와 함께 천천히 늙어 가는 것”이라고. 사실 우리를 감동시키는 것은 삶 속의 소박한 사랑이다. 때로는 단순함이 가장 큰 행복이다.
translation.ja: 多くの女の子はロマンチックな愛に憧れる。では、ロマンとは何だろうか。若い人は、彼女が月を欲しがるときに星をあげないことだと言う。中年の人は、夜遅くまで残業して零時に帰宅しても、家の灯りがまだついていることだと言う。年配の人は、ロマンとは歌にあるように「私が思ういちばんロマンチックなことは、あなたと一緒にゆっくり年を重ねること」だと言う。実は、私たちの心を動かすのは暮らしの中の素朴な愛だ。時には、シンプルであることこそが最大の幸せなのだ。
translation.en: Many girls envy romantic love. So what is romance? Young people say: romance is when she wants the moon, you won't give her a star; middle-aged people say: romance is even when working overtime until midnight, when you get home, the light in your house is still on; elderly people say: romance is actually like what is sung in the song, 'The most romantic thing I can think of is growing old with you slowly.' In fact, what moves us is the simple love in life. Sometimes, simplicity is the greatest happiness.

translation.ko: 결혼 이야기가 나오면 사람들은 자연스럽게 사랑을 떠올리게 된다. 사랑은 결혼의 중요한 이유이지만, 두 사람이 함께 살아가려면 낭만적인 사랑만 필요한 것이 아니라 성격 면에서도 서로 끌려야 한다. 내 남편은 아주 유머 있는 사람이다. 아주 평범한 일도 그의 입에서 나오면 재미있어진다. 내가 힘들 때 그는 늘 나를 기쁘게 할 방법을 찾아낸다. 게다가 성미도 좋다. 결혼한 지 거의 10년이 되었지만 우리는 거의 어떤 일로도 얼굴을 붉힌 적이 없어서 많은 사람들이 특히 우리를 부러워한다.
translation.ja: 結婚の話になると、人は自然に愛情を思い浮かべる。愛情は結婚の大切な理由だが、二人が一緒に生活するにはロマンチックな愛だけでなく、性格の面でも互いに引かれ合うことが必要だ。私の夫はとてもユーモアのある人で、ごく普通のことでも彼の口から出ると面白くなる。私がつらいとき、彼はいつも私を元気にする方法を見つけてくれる。そのうえ気性もよく、結婚してもうすぐ10年になるが、私たちはほとんど何かで顔を赤くして言い争ったことがない。だから多くの人がとくに私たちをうらやましがる。
translation.en: When it comes to marriage, people naturally think of love. Love is an important reason for marriage, but living together not only requires romantic love, but also mutual attraction in personality. My husband is a very humorous person. Even very ordinary things become interesting when spoken from his mouth. When I am sad, he always has a way to cheer me up. And his temper is also quite good. Having been married for nearly ten years, we two have almost never turned red (argued) over anything; many people especially envy us.
